messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii**

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April** | Warm, sunny days (average 78 °F / 26 °C), lower crowds after the spring break rush, and plenty of outdoor activities. |
| **May** | Similar weather to April, but even fewer tourists and often better hotel rates. |
| **September** | Post‑summer crowds thin out, temperatures stay comfortable (avg 80 °F / 27 °C), and the ocean is still warm for swimming and surfing. |
| **October** | Mild temperatures (avg 79 °F / 26 °C), quieter beaches, and the chance to catch the tail end of the humpback whale migration. |
| **November** | Still warm (avg 77 °F / 25 °C), fewer visitors, and the start of the winter surf season for experienced surfers. |

### Quick comparison of average temperatures (Hawaii – Honolulu)

| Month | Avg. Temp (°F) | Avg. Temp (°C) |
|-------|----------------|----------------|
| Jan | 77 | 25 |
| Feb | 78 | 26 |
| Mar | 78 | 26 |
| Apr | 78 | 26 |
| May | 79 | 27 |
| Jun | 80 | 27 |
| Jul | 81 | 27 |
| Aug | 81 | 27 |
| Sep | 80 | 27 |
| Oct | 79 | 27 |
| Nov | 78 | 26 |
| Dec | 77 | 25 |

> **Bottom line:** If you’re looking for the best balance of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for **April, May, September, October, or November**. July and August are peak season—hotter, busier, and pricier—while December and January are cooler but still mild and great for winter travelers.
